{"outcome": "succeeded", "arguments": {"file_path": "/work/.claude/skills/honey-wholesale-shipment-orders/scripts/honey_shipment.py"}, "tool_name": "Read", "truncated": false, "duration_ms": 14, "invocation_id": "call_TSUcwxs6uTZElsfRAIYFwdti", "result_summary": "1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Turn Chinese honey wholesale order text into checked shipment orders."""
3	import argparse
4	import datetime as dt
5	import re
6	import sys
7	
8	PRODUCTS = [
9	    ("蜂蜜 250ml", 180, "瓶", re.compile(r"蜂蜜\s*250\s*ml", re.I)),
10	    ("蜂蜜 500ml", 320, "瓶", re.compile(r"蜂蜜\s*500\s*ml", re.I)),
11	    ("蜂蠟蠟燭", 90, "支", re.compile(r"蜂蠟\s*蠟燭|蠟燭", re.I)),
12	]
13	
14	
15	class OneLineParser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
16	    def error(self, message):
17	        print(f"錯誤：{message}", file=sys.stderr)
18	        raise SystemExit(2)
19	
20	
21	def parse_date(value, option):
22	    try:
23	        parsed = dt.date.fromisoformat(value)
24	        if parsed.isoformat() != value:
25	            raise ValueError
26	        return parsed
27	    except ValueError:
28	        print(f"無法使用 {option} 的值「{value}」：請提供有效的 YYYY-MM-DD 日期。", file=sys.stderr)
29	        raise SystemExit(2)
30	
31	
32	def split_orders(text):
33	    matches = list(re.finditer(r"(?m)^\s*訂單\s*[:：]\s*([^\r\n]*)", text))
34	    if not matches:
35	        return [("未提供", text)]
36	    orders = []
37	    for index, match in enumerate(matches):
38	        end = matches[index + 1].start() if index + 1 < len(matches) else len(text)
39	        name = match.group(1).strip() or "未提供"
40	        orders.append((name, text[match.end():end]))
41	    return orders
42	
43	
44	def parse_items(block):
45	    found = {name: [] for name, _, _, _ in PRODUCTS}
46	    invalid = {name: [] for name, _, _, _ in PRODUCTS}
47	    for line in block.splitlines():
48	        for name, _, _, pattern in PRODUCTS:
49	            match = pattern.search(line)
50	            if not match:
51	                continue
52	            tail = line[match.end():]
53	            quantity_match = re.search(r"(?:[:：]\s*)?([+-]?\d+)(?![\d.])\s*(?:瓶|支|個|件)?", tail)
54	            if quantity_match:
55	                found[name].append(quantity_match.group(1))
56	            else:
57	                raw = re.sub(r"^\s*[:：]?\s*", "", tail).strip() or "未提供"
58	                invalid[name].append(raw)
59	            break
60	    return found, invalid
61	
62	
63	def render_order(name, block, today):
64	    date_match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*出貨日期\s*[:：]\s*([^\s]+)", block)
65	    date_issue = None
66	    assumed = False
67	    if date_match:
68	        raw_date = date_match.group(1)
69	        try:
70	            parsed_date = dt.date.fromisoformat(raw_date)
71	            if parsed_date.isoformat() != raw_date:
72	                raise ValueError
73	            shipment_date = raw_date
74	        except ValueError:
75	            shipment_date = raw_date
76	            date_issue = f"出貨日期「{raw_date}」不是有效日期，請你確認原日期。"
77	    else:
78	        shipment_date = today.isoformat()
79	        assumed = True
80	
81	    values, invalid = parse_items(block)
82	    rows = []
83	    problems = []
84	    known_subtotals = []
85	    has_item = False
86	    for product, price, unit, _ in PRODUCTS:
87	        entries = values[product]
88	        bad_entries = invalid[product]
89	        if not entries and not bad_entries:
90	            continue
91	        has_item = True
92	        distinct = list(dict.fromkeys(entries))
93	        if bad_entries:
94	            shown = "、".join(bad_entries)
95	            rows.append((product, f"無法辨識（{shown}）", price, "不計"))
96	            problems.append(f"{product} 數量「{shown}」無法辨識，請你確認數量。")
97	        elif any(int(value) < 0 for value in entries):
98	            shown = "、".join(distinct)
99	            rows.append((product, f"{shown} {unit}", price, "不計"))
100	            problems.append(f"{product} 數量為負數（{shown}），請你確認數量。")
101	        elif len(distinct) > 1:
102	            shown = "、".join(f"{value} {unit}" for value in distinct)
103	            rows.append((product, f"待確認：{shown}", price, "不計"))
104	            problems.append(f"{product} 出現不同數量（{shown}），請你確認正確數量。")
105	        else:
106	            quantity = int(distinct[0])
107	            subtotal = quantity * price
108	            rows.append((product, f"{quantity} {unit}", price, subtotal))
109	            known_subtotals.append(subtotal)
110	
111	    print(f"### 訂單：{name}")
112	    print(f"出貨日期：{shipment_date}")
113	    if assumed:
114	        print(f"假設：缺少出貨日期，採用 {shipment_date}；可用 --today 更改。")
115	    if date_issue:
116	        print(f"需你確認：{date_issue}")
117	    print("| 品項 | 數量 | 單價（元） | 小計（元） |")
118	    print("|---|---:|---:|---:|")
119	    if rows:
120	        for product, quantity, price, subtotal in rows:
121	            print(f"| {product} | {quantity} | {price} | {subtotal} |")
122	    else:
123	        print("| 未提供 | 未提供 | — | — |")
124	    for problem in problems:
125	        print(f"需你確認：{problem}")
126	    if not has_item:
127	        print("訂單總額：未提供（沒有可計算的品項數量）。")
128	    elif date_issue or problems:
129	        print("訂單總額：不計（有待確認資料）。")
130	    else:
131	        print(f"訂單總額：{sum(known_subtotals)} 元")
132	    print()
133	
134	
135	def main():
136	    parser = OneLineParser(description="整理蜂蜜批發訂購文字並計算出貨單金額")
137	    parser.add_argument("--text", required=True, help="完整訂購訊息文字")
138	    parser.add_argument("--today", help="缺少出貨日期時採用的 YYYY-MM-DD 日期；預設為執行當日")
139	    args = parser.parse_args()
140	    today = parse_date(args.today, "--today") if args.today else dt.date.today()
141	    for name, block in split_orders(args.text):
142	        render_order(name, block, today)
143	
144	
145	if __name__ == "__main__":
146	    main()
